limits: No soil, rock abundance, humidity or rainfall inferred from terrain
Earth matches explain regional morphology only; landcover/logistics not screened for new coordinates
All clicks in a type return same Earth catalog; per-click optimality is not claimed
0.5-degree lookup approximates original 10 km grid; boundaries are approximate
climate_status: Additional layers are separate from terrain clustering and analog matching.

mars_climate.notes: Nearest coarse model node; not present weather, annual mean, or terrain category. Humidity/precipitation not obtained.

matching_method.retrieval: Exact nearest-neighbor retrieval to each trained prototype in shared feature space
matching_method.transform: log1p, then subtract training Mars median and divide by training Mars IQR
matching_method.diversity: Select three sequentially with spherical Earth separation >500 km, scanning up to 20000 nearest locations
matching_method.cover: After terrain selection, show bare/sparse>=50% candidates first within the fixed shortlist
matching_method.scope: Regional morphology, not material classification, climate equivalence or passability
matching_method.explanation: Exact additive squared-distance contributions; not SHAP or causal effects
